title: Band personnel and earlier pianists; other women pianists
summary: She names members of the band when she joined, says earlier pianists included Sweet Emma, and names other women pianists in the city.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Okay. Who was in the band when you joined them? Can you remember?

Paul Vaughn, Mrs. Elliston, John Marrera, Simon Marrera, and a fellow playing trombone, and a trombone named Marr. Oh, I just can't think of his name now, but there was a trombone player. And I think that's, oh, at the time that I joined, it was a small group.
Was that, I mean, did they have a piano player in the band before you?
Yes, they said they had had Sweet Amel and several others.
So, so you weren't the first woman to play the band. Oh, yes. Was there, did you see many women playing piano with bands around here out of the... Yes.
Mercedes Fields, who is dead now, and Wilhelmina Bart, who is also dead, and a friend of mine, Ruby May Townsend, who is also dead, all three of whom I can remember.
